parsed.justification: Rationale A correctly notes the comment does not specify a section/table/figure, but it doesn't clearly arrive at a score or explain why the comment is not 'fully grounded' in rubric terms—it conflates grounding with specificity. Rationale B correctly interprets that the '4.' is a comment number (not a section reference), accurately assesses that the authors cannot pinpoint the part, but the comment does specify what needs addressing with concrete examples (SimVLM, OFA). B correctly maps this to score 3 per the rubric. B is stronger across all dimensions.
